notes.title: T&T 5-Years Anniversary and Colouring Event!
notes.content:
An illustration to celebrate T&T's 5 year anniversary!
Art by LighT (Twitter)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26214963/a904ca69ac8825ae1940b356e7f328720792f3e2.jpg

Thank you for these five years!
I’m really grateful, and hope that I had brought you some laughters.
Please continue to stay around for my future projects if you’re interested!

Aaaaannd some exciting news!
[spoiler](It's the same as in the previous news that I think hardly anyone can see...anyway I'm posting it here!) [/spoiler]

1) The new official website is online now! 
Thanks to Vilja (who's also the programmer of T&TR)! 
You can check all the news, game information, walkthroughs on the website, and more contents are planning to be updated.

2) A Popularity Vote!
This is going to be the 3rd Popularity Vote, to celebrate RRoL's release and T&T's 5 year(!) anniversary. The 1st & 2nd results can be found in the previous news. 

* You don't have to play all the games to vote.
* End Date is to be announced, but at least it'll be the end of August. Please take your time playing!


3) Colour the Secret Pumpkin Garden
Thanks to the artist LighT!
I really love this illustration and we joked that it was like from a colouring book. They generously provided the beautiful line art, and we decided to hold this event as a part of celebration~

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26214963/b686313a0c01c7b2780f330d3116327c73002fbf.jpg

You can print it or colour it digitally. Please have fun!
~Just do not repost the original art or the line art, or claim the line art as your own~

◇ Rules and Download Link Here ◇

Please read the rules before downloading~
We’re looking forward to see your works!


There are also some other events going on, check the "Events" page if you're interested!~
I have to say it's not easy for a small solo dev. Thank you very much for your support! 
Please take care and have fun playing!ːtwtpbearː

~ Official Website ~
For regular news and dev progress (and to support the dev):
Dev blog | Twitter | Patreon

Thanks for reading and have a nice day~ːtwtpteaː

notes.title: TWTP Update, Hello Charlotte and a New Project!☆
notes.content:
☆TWTP Update
As planned,  The Witches' Tea Party  will have a v2.0 in June (probabily next week).

In the new version:
+ Lnaguages can be changed in the game.
+ Thai localization added! (Thanks to the hard work of Whateverzone!)
+ A new outfit unlocked for the second run (just like in T&T!)

The game's system has been changed therefore the old save data cannot be used in the new version! Please TURN OFF the Steam auto-update to avoid losing your progress.
There is also a Light version without the steam features on  itch.io , which should have a better performance.
There's no new content in the second run except the outfit [strike]but I hope you can enjoy it anyway[/strike].


☆ Hello Charlotte
I'm honored to have the chance to translate the amazing games of  Hello Charlotte into Chinese! 
The Chinese version of EP2 will be released soon, and EP1 is already for downloading on the  CN blog . 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/1e586048d0eedad547319e9e90f684d81378495e.jpg


☆ The New Project: Airi's Adventure
The new RPG in development is also going to have a demo soon. The development is basically done yet the translation and testing will still take some time (hopefully in the end of June [strike]though I'm not very confident with my schedule...[/strike]).
It's a very casual (and traditional) turn-based JRPG.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/f667cef3b5efdacc359ffa251d38f14e96d0cbae.png 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29675996/85a804597fcd81eb1b573629c790a732cf60b8e6.png
If you're interested please check  the dev blog  for more infomation : )
Or follow on  Twitter  :D

Thanks again for all the support!
